     7→ * @param {String|null} activeChatId - 当前活跃会话ID（用于跨会话校验）
     8→ * @returns {Array} 合并后的消息列表
     9→ */
    10→export function mergeCurrentMessage(historyList, currentMessage, activeChatId = null) {
    11→  const history = historyList || []
    12→
    13→  if (!currentMessage) {
    14→    return [...history]
    15→  }
    16→
    17→  // 校验当前消息是否属于当前会话（防止会话切换时消息混乱）
    18→  if (currentMessage.chatId && activeChatId && currentMessage.chatId !== activeChatId) {
    19→    console.warn('[mergeCurrentMessage] 跨会话消息', {
    20→      currentChatId: currentMessage.chatId,
    21→      activeChatId
    22→    })
    23→    return [...history]
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  // 将当前流式消息合并到历史列表中
    27→  const existingIndex = history.findIndex(m => m.id === currentMessage.id)
    28→  if (existingIndex !== -1) {
    29→    const merged = [...history]
    30→    merged[existingIndex] = { ...merged[existingIndex], ...currentMessage }
    31→    return merged
    32→  }
    33→
    34→  return [...history, currentMessage]
    35→}
